scenes.headline: How a decision model reads a document knowing the question
scenes.sub: Perplexity's decider v1.1, read from its weights and code.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tally! Perplexity's new decision model returns a probability for every option. One small change explains both its lead and its bill.

scenes.text: Version 1.1 removes the causal mask in its 16 full-attention layers, so the document is read with the question already in view.
scenes.mark: read with the question already in view
scenes.say: In a quarter of its layers, every token may look forward, so the document is read knowing what will be asked.

steps.say: The base is a hybrid. Three recurrent layers read the prompt strictly left to right.
Every fourth layer is ordinary attention, and here the mask is gone. State tokens can see the question and options.
The last token is read by two hundred fifty five rows of the base model's own output layer.

steps.label: version 1, every layer
steps.say: In version one, every layer is causal. A document token is encoded before the question exists.

steps.label: version 1.1, full-attention layers
steps.say: In the new attention layers, every token sees every other one.
The price: the document's encoding now depends on the question, so it cannot be cached and shared.
Each question becomes its own complete prompt, with the whole document copied in.

parts.say: Multiply by the number of questions.
Sixty eight tokens of wrapper each.
And the whole document, every time.

scenes.label: tokens in the docs' own example, reproduced to the token
scenes.say: The docs' own example bills three hundred sixty seven tokens. One prompt per question gives exactly that.

scenes.title: Decision Index 0.3, full score
scenes.note: On public benchmarks alone, Torchcast leads at 65.1
scenes.say: It does top the new index, and wins on the private tests nobody can train on. On public benchmarks alone, another model leads.

scenes.text: Reading the document with the question in view wins decisions, but nothing can be shared between questions.
scenes.mark: nothing can be shared between questions
scenes.say: Reading with the question in view wins decisions, and costs a full pass per question.

recap: 16 attention layers lose the causal mask
Each question is its own full prompt
scenes.say: Sixteen layers lose the mask, each question pays for the document, and the lead holds where it counts.
